title: Suppress AS0099 for existing extension field IDs
summary: Added AS0099 suppression pragmas for 70 existing extension fields across multiple apps to preserve schema compatibility while acknowledging their allocation outside app ranges.
key_points: Suppresses AS0099 analyzer warnings for extension fields outside allocated ranges
Preserves field IDs for schema compatibility rather than renumbering
Covers E-Document Core, Expense Agent, Field Service Integration, Sustainability, and localization apps
Narrow, targeted suppressions around affected fields only
No runtime logic or manifest changes; diagnostic suppression only
